prerequisites: Having met the requirements of the LESPA1102 course or being able to demonstrate that the student already has the prerequisite level through a certificate or an oral level test with the teacher.
Having the A2+ level in listening and reading comprehension and the A2 level in speaking and writing.

learning_outcomes.text: Have a regular communicative competence in Spanish, allowing the learner to understand and express themselves, both in written and oral fashion, in clear standard language, on everyday situations.
Make clear oral and written descriptions of events, activities and personal experiences.
Exchange information about activities occurring in everyday life.
Tell simple and coherent stories about familiar subjects, narrate events experienced, etc.
Describe experiences, events, express wishes and ambitions, as well as briefly justify one's opinions or explain one's projects.

teaching_methods: E-learning content via UCLouvain platforms (Teams, Moodle)
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment includes several written tests, an oral test, and assignments. For December and June terms, the written exam is 45%, the oral exam is 40%, and continuous assessment is 15%. For the September term, the written exam is 50% and the oral exam is 50%. Generative artificial intelligence may not be used, its use will be considered cheating.
